notes: Company background: streaming personalization platform, realtime recommendations + chat in player
Primary ask: Dedicated capacity with strict per-route latency SLOs (p95 < 100ms for chat endpoints) and 99.9% uptime
Throughput target: sustained 1200 concurrent chat streams, burst to 3000 for premieres; embeddings for offline indexing ~5M/day
Cost sensitivity: moderate-high; want predictability more than lowest unit cost
Model preference: open models (Llama2/Redwood-verified variants) with quantized 8-bit options; fallback to smaller encoder for low-priority traffic
Routing/fallback needs: per-customer and per-route priority lanes; graceful fallback to low-cost model if Dedicated tier limited
Tenant isolation requirements: strict KV cache isolation per tenant, per-tenant telemetry, and ability to evict tenant cache on demand
Traffic shaping ask: per-route quotas, weighted priority lanes (bronze/silver/gold), request shaping based on real-time utilization metrics
Noisy-neighbor controls: auto-throttle at route-level, emergency circuit-breaker, and GPU reservation windows
SLA negotiation points: credits tied to latency SLO misses at p95/p99, clearer definitions for planned vs unplanned maintenance
Quote from CTO on 2026-01-08 call: 'We care about predictability — if latency holds, we can scale UX aggressively.'
POC observations: initial autoscaler under-configured for prefix caching; KV cache thrashing during premieres caused p95 spikes
Suggested Redwood solutions: tenant-aware batching, per-queue token budgets, priority lanes that reserve GPU shards for gold routes
Security items: KMS + HSM preferred for key management; retention controls for user conversations; SOC2 evidence request (control matrix)
Commercial notes: procurement wants 12/24 month committed capacity pricing options; legal asked for data residency clause for EU users
Internal contacts: Product lead - Nora Bishop; Infra lead - Daniel Chen; Legal - Sofia Marquez
Open engineering tickets: JIRA-ENG-8932 (cache eviction policy), JIRA-SEC-719 (KMS integrations)
use_case_summary: Real-time chat personalization across live streaming; critical latency for chat and reranking during premieres; batch embeddings for content indexing. Need Dedicated with traffic shaping (priority lanes) to protect high-value routes and prevent noisy-neighbor impact on p95/p99 SLA.
